question: Muninn article benchmark: breakouts taken while the Nifty 10-DMA is above its 20-DMA (higher ma1020 ratio) should do better -- expect higher ratio = better
plain: The article's only rule that survived out-of-sample data was 'index 10-day average above the 20-day'; this checks whether that simple Nifty trend gate grades our tight-base breakouts.
